blocks.text: Anthropic 在今日修订的 S1 文件中披露，与微软和谷歌达成了超过 100 亿美元的新协议。

inlines.text: Anthropic 在今日修订的 S1 文件中披露，与微软和谷歌达成了超过 100 亿美元的新协议。

blocks.text: 微软协议目前涵盖截至 2033 年 6 月至少 472 亿美元、最高 492 亿美元的支出，高于此前 449 亿美元的最低值。

blocks.text: Anthropic reveals in its amended S1 filing today, more than $10 billion in new agreements with Microsoft and Google.

inlines.text: Anthropic reveals in its amended S1 filing today, more than $10 billion in new agreements with Microsoft and Google.

blocks.text: The Microsoft deal now covers at least $47.2B and up to $49.2B of spending through June 2033, up from a $44.9B minimum.

inlines.text: The Microsoft deal now covers at least $47.2B and up to $49.2B of spending through June 2033, up from a $44.9B minimum.

blocks.text: Google’s minimum rose from about $114.5B to about $121.3B through July 2033, and both deals must be paid whether or not Anthropic uses the capacity.

blocks.text: That extra long-term capacity could ease its reliance on short-term compute, which cost $5.0B last quarter at significantly higher prices.
